name: zayros-smm-bot
description: Telegram account manager with MongoDB/GridFS persistence

MONGO_GRIDFS_BUCKET.description: GridFS bucket for sessions, bot session and audio

STORAGE_SYNC_INTERVAL.description: Runtime session sync interval in seconds

ACCOUNT_SHARDING.description: Use one account worker shard per up to ACCOUNT_SHARD_SIZE sessions

ACCOUNT_SHARD_SIZE.description: Maximum Telegram account sessions owned by one worker

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: This Heroku app name, required for automatic worker scaling

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku Platform API key used only by worker.1 to scale workers

DASHBOARD_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Heroku web dashboard

DASHBOARD_SESSION_SECRET.description: Random secret used to sign dashboard browser sessions
